# invest.db schema (generated by `db.py schema --md`; version 1)

One SQLite file at `<project>/data/invest.db`, created and migrated by the first script that runs. Every numeric row carries `source_id` pointing at `sources`, which holds the URL the report links to. Holdings are never stored; reports are files under `data/reports/`.

## sources

Where every number came from: one row per URL, with its grade and the last fetch time.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| id | INTEGER PRIMARY KEY | row id, referenced by every data row as source_id |
| url | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE | the raw source, keys redacted; the link the report shows |
| grade | TEXT NOT NULL | primary = the issuer's or the government's own data (SEC, FRED); secondary = a vendor (Yahoo, a news feed); derived = computed by a script from rows that have their own sources |
| title | TEXT | what the link is, in a few words |
| fetched_at | TEXT NOT NULL | ISO UTC of the last fetch |

## securities

One row per ticker: what it is, its SEC id, sector and industry.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ticker | TEXT PRIMARY KEY | US ticker, upper case |
| name | TEXT | company or fund name |
| cik | TEXT | SEC Central Index Key, 10 digits, NULL for a fund with none |
| kind | TEXT | stock or fund (ETF) |
| exchange | TEXT | listing exchange |
| sector | TEXT | Yahoo sector |
| industry | TEXT | Yahoo industry |
| currency | TEXT | quote currency, USD for everything this plugin covers |
| source_id | INTEGER, refs sources(id) | profile source |
| updated_at | TEXT NOT NULL | ISO UTC |

## prices

Daily prices, one row per ticker and trading day.

Key: `(ticker, date)`

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ticker | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| date | TEXT NOT NULL | YYYY-MM-DD |
| open | REAL |  |
| high | REAL |  |
| low | REAL |  |
| close | REAL NOT NULL | unadjusted close |
| adj_close | REAL | close adjusted for splits and dividends; use for returns |
| volume | INTEGER |  |
| source_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs sources(id) |  |

## fundamentals

SEC XBRL facts in long form: one row per concept, unit and period, the latest filing wins.

Key: `(ticker, concept, unit, period_end, period_start)`

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ticker | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| concept | TEXT NOT NULL | XBRL concept without namespace, e.g. Revenues, NetIncomeLoss |
| unit | TEXT NOT NULL | USD, shares, USD/shares, pure |
| period_start | TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' | YYYY-MM-DD for a duration fact, '' for an instant (balance sheet) |
| period_end | TEXT NOT NULL | YYYY-MM-DD |
| days | INTEGER | duration in days; ~365 annual, ~91 quarterly, NULL for an instant |
| fy | INTEGER | fiscal year of the filing that reported it |
| fp | TEXT | FY, Q1, Q2, Q3 |
| form | TEXT | 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, ... |
| filed | TEXT | filing date; of all filings reporting this period, the latest is kept (restatements win) |
| accession | TEXT | accession number of that filing |
| frame | TEXT | SEC calendar frame such as CY2023 or CY2023Q4I when the SEC assigned one |
| value | REAL NOT NULL |  |
| source_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs sources(id) | the companyfacts API call |

## macro_series

The macro series followed, one row each.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| series | TEXT PRIMARY KEY | FRED id, e.g. DGS10, CPIAUCSL, FEDFUNDS, UNRATE, T10Y2Y |
| title | TEXT |  |
| units | TEXT | percent, index, thousands of persons, ... |
| frequency | TEXT | daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly |
| source_id | INTEGER, refs sources(id) |  |
| updated_at | TEXT NOT NULL |  |

## macro

Observations of the macro series.

Key: `(series, date)`

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| series | TEXT NOT NULL, refs macro_series(series) |  |
| date | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| value | REAL NOT NULL |  |

## estimates

Analysts' consensus as of a date: price targets, recommendation, next earnings date (secondary).

Key: `(ticker, asof)`

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ticker | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| asof | TEXT NOT NULL | YYYY-MM-DD of the fetch |
| target_mean | REAL |  |
| target_median | REAL |  |
| target_high | REAL |  |
| target_low | REAL |  |
| analysts | INTEGER | number of analysts behind the targets |
| recommendation | TEXT | buy, hold, sell as Yahoo words it |
| recommendation_mean | REAL | 1 strong buy .. 5 sell |
| next_earnings | TEXT | YYYY-MM-DD when known |
| source_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs sources(id) |  |

## funds

What a fund is: category, what it tracks, its yearly cost.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ticker | TEXT PRIMARY KEY, refs securities(ticker) |  |
| category | TEXT | Yahoo category, e.g. Large Growth, Trading--Leveraged Equity |
| tracks | TEXT | the index or strategy named in the summary |
| expense_ratio | REAL | yearly cost as a fraction, 0.002 = 0.20% |
| net_assets | REAL | USD |
| inception | TEXT | YYYY-MM-DD |
| summary | TEXT | the fund's own description, trimmed |
| asof | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| source_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs sources(id) |  |

## fund_weights

A fund's top holdings and sector weights as of a date.

Key: `(fund, kind, key, asof)`

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| fund | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| kind | TEXT NOT NULL | holding = a constituent, sector = a sector bucket |
| key | TEXT NOT NULL | constituent ticker or sector name |
| name | TEXT | constituent name |
| weight | REAL NOT NULL | fraction of the fund, 0.08 = 8% |
| asof | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| source_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs sources(id) |  |

## news

News items per subject; the analyst records the lean after reading.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| id | INTEGER PRIMARY KEY |  |
| subject | TEXT NOT NULL | a ticker, 'sector:<name>' or 'market' |
| published | TEXT | ISO UTC |
| source | TEXT | publisher |
| url | TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE |  |
| title | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| summary | TEXT | one line, as the feed gave it |
| lean | REAL | -1 against .. +1 for the subject; NULL until read |
| lean_by | TEXT | who set the lean: 'analyst' with the run id, never a script |
| lean_note | TEXT | why, in a few words |
| source_id | INTEGER, refs sources(id) | the feed the item came from |
| fetched_at | TEXT NOT NULL |  |

## runs

One row per question asked: how it was read, the plan, where the report went.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| id | INTEGER PRIMARY KEY |  |
| asked_at | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| question | TEXT NOT NULL | verbatim |
| intent | TEXT NOT NULL | the advisor's reading; digest for the daily digest |
| subjects | TEXT NOT NULL | JSON list of tickers or sector names |
| plan | TEXT | JSON list of steps, each a script call or a cited research step |
| status | TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' |  |
| report_path | TEXT | data/reports/<date>-<slug>.md once written |
| notes | TEXT | what went wrong or was skipped |

## views

One dimension's reading of one subject in one run: the unit the verdict is composed from.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| id | INTEGER PRIMARY KEY |  |
| run_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |  |
| subject | TEXT NOT NULL | ticker or sector |
| dimension | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| stance | TEXT NOT NULL | for the subject, against it, or neither |
| strength | INTEGER NOT NULL | 1 weak, 2 clear, 3 strong |
| horizon | TEXT | months or 'structural' |
| sentence | TEXT NOT NULL | the reading in one sentence, with its figures |
| evidence | TEXT NOT NULL | JSON list of source ids the sentence rests on |
| created_at | TEXT NOT NULL |  |

## stats

Price statistics computed by stats.py as of a date.

Key: `(ticker, asof, metric, window)`

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ticker | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| asof | TEXT NOT NULL | last price date used |
| metric | TEXT NOT NULL | e.g. cagr, volatility, max_drawdown, beta, ma50, ma200, high_52w, low_52w |
| window | TEXT NOT NULL | 1y, 3y, 5y or 'spot' |
| value | REAL NOT NULL |  |
| source_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs sources(id) | derived; the prices rows are the inputs |

## valuations

Value estimates: the DCF's three scenarios, the reverse DCF, and the P/E cross-checks; inputs kept with each.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| id | INTEGER PRIMARY KEY |  |
| run_id | INTEGER, refs runs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL |  |
| ticker | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| asof | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| method | TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dcf' | dcf = a scenario; reverse_dcf = the growth the price implies (value = price); pe_range = EPS x the stock's own median P/E; pe_peers = EPS x the peers' median P/E |
| scenario | TEXT | low, base or high for a dcf row; NULL otherwise |
| inputs | TEXT NOT NULL | JSON: every assumption and its origin; for the P/E rows the multiples themselves |
| value_per_share | REAL NOT NULL |  |
| price | REAL | price on asof |
| upside | REAL | value / price - 1 |
| p10 | REAL | Monte Carlo 10th percentile of value per share |
| p50 | REAL | median |
| p90 | REAL | 90th percentile |
| source_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs sources(id) | derived |
| created_at | TEXT NOT NULL |  |

## calls

Every recommendation made, with its confidence, and later what actually happened.

| column | type | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| id | INTEGER PRIMARY KEY |  |
| run_id | INTEGER NOT NULL, refs runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE |  |
| ticker | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| tier | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| action | TEXT NOT NULL |  |
| limit_price | REAL | the price the action is tied to, when there is one |
| size | TEXT | shares, a weight, or words |
| horizon_months | INTEGER NOT NULL |  |
| expected_return | REAL | fraction over the horizon, when stated |
| confidence | INTEGER NOT NULL |  |
| confidence_parts | TEXT NOT NULL | JSON {evidence, agreement, record} with the reason for each |
| believe | TEXT | what you have to believe for this tier |
| evidence | TEXT NOT NULL | JSON list of source ids |
| price_at_call | REAL |  |
| spy_at_call | REAL |  |
| made_at | TEXT NOT NULL | YYYY-MM-DD |
| due_at | TEXT NOT NULL | made_at + horizon |
| realised_at | TEXT | date the outcome was scored |
| realised_price | REAL |  |
| spy_realised | REAL |  |
| outcome | TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' | right = the price moved the way the action implied by due_at, wrong = it did not, void = unscorable |

## Views

- `latest_prices`: The last close per ticker.
- `fundamentals_annual`: Annual duration facts (350-380 days) and the instants (balance sheet) dated at a fiscal year end; an instant is annual when an annual duration of the same ticker ends on its date, whatever filing last reported it.
- `fundamentals_quarterly`: Quarterly duration facts (80-100 days) and the instants dated at a quarter end that is not a fiscal year end.
- `track_record`: Scored calls per tier and action: how many were right.

## Enumerations

- intents: stock, holdings, sector, macro, mix, digest
- dimensions: fundamentals, valuation, statistics, macro, industry, sentiment
- stances: for, against, neutral
- tiers: conservative, moderate, aggressive
- actions: buy, add, hold, trim, sell, wait, avoid
- grades: primary, secondary, derived
- scenarios: low, base, high
- valuation methods: dcf, reverse_dcf, pe_range, pe_peers
- outcomes: open, right, wrong, void
